tvShow.name: Numberblocks
tvShow.overview: Learn how much fun counting can be with the Numberblocks - a fun-loving group of numbers who work together to solve problems big and small.

episodes.name: The Treasure of Hexagon Island
episodes.overview: Get ready for a special pirate adventure as the Numberblocks set sail in search of treasure. They have to solve Captain Hexbeard's riddles to find it. Learn how to solve puzzles with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Double Back
episodes.overview: It's time for a time travel adventure! Sixty-Four's new time machine keeps sending the Numberblocks back in time. Can they double up in time to fix it? Learn about doubling with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: About Time
episodes.overview: Tick, tock, a broken clock! Can the Numberblocks fix it, learn to tell the time and have a song and dance before time runs out? Learn how to tell the time with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Twelve Days of Christmas
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks present a special numbery version of the festive favourite featuring a Christmas train that flings gifts into the air. What could possibly go wrong? Learn about counting, adding and number patterns with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Five Little Speckled Frogs
episodes.overview: Sing along with this number song about five speckled frogs.

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Zoom Zoom Zoom!
episodes.overview: Learn to count backwards from 10 as we head off into space!

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Scoop a Scoop
episodes.overview: Sing along with this counting song about ice cream scoops.

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Who Has More?
episodes.overview: A dog and a cat are having a lovely picnic, but who has more buns?

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Five Little Boats
episodes.overview: Sing along and learn about number order with five little sail boats.

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Days of Spring
episodes.overview: Sing along and celebrate spring with this number song.

episodes.name: Numbersongs: How Many Passengers?
episodes.overview: Join in with this song about bus passengers.

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Let's All Draw Numbers
episodes.overview: Sing along and learn how to draw numbers 1 to 10.

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Hen House Hop
episodes.overview: Can you tell which number is missing in the Hen House Hop?

episodes.name: Numbersongs: Counting Cars
episodes.overview: Sing along with this counting song about cars.

episodes.name: How Many Sleeps til' Christmas?
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks just can't wait for Christmas Day and are counting down the sleeps until Santa arrives. Just like everyone else, the Numberblocks love celebrating Christmas, sharing gifts and being with their friends. Sing along and dance to this Christmas song all about counting down from 25 to 1! Less

episodes.name: Numberblocks Birthday Song
episodes.overview: Happy birthday! Count on the Numberblocks to make a birthday add up to a top celebration.

episodes.name: Making Christmas Magical
episodes.overview: Alphablocks, Colourblocks and Wonderblocks celebrate the holidays in snowy Numberland!

episodes.name: One
episodes.overview: A little block falls out of the sky, meets her numberling and discovers one wonderful world, singing and counting to one. Learn all about the number 1 with Numberblock One!

episodes.name: Another One
episodes.overview: One discovers it's tricky to play tennis when you're the only block in the world. She bumps into a magic mirror and meets another One, and they join forces to make Two. Learn a thing or two about adding with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Two
episodes.overview: Two finds a pair of magic dancing shoes and shows One that everything is better with two, singing and counting things that belong in pairs. Learn all about the number two with Numberblock Two.

episodes.name: Three
episodes.overview: Three arrives with a bang and a song-and-dance about her favourite number - 1, 2, 3, Everybody Look at Me! Learn all about the number three with Numberblock Three.

episodes.name: One, Two, Three!
episodes.overview: Three does magic tricks with apples to show the others who goes first, who is biggest and how to surprise your number friends. Learn about simple counting, ordering and adding with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Four
episodes.overview: The animated adventures of friends who can always count on each other. Four is the new block on the block and he can't wait to share how much he loves to be square.

episodes.name: Five
episodes.overview: The animated adventures of friends who can always count on each other. Five arrives to get the band together, and the party started, with a big high five.

episodes.name: Three Little Pigs
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks present their very own, very numbery version of the classic tale The Three Little Pigs and the Big Bad Square. Learn about adding ones and simple counting with the number friends.

episodes.name: Off We Go
episodes.overview: Five and friends set off on a rhyming romp through field and forest

episodes.name: How to Count
episodes.overview: It is a lovely day for a picnic, but one of the flapjacks is missing!

episodes.name: Stampolines
episodes.overview: Three opens a stampoline park, where her friends have splatty fun making inky prints.

episodes.name: The Whole of Me
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks perform a song and dance all about the parts that make a whole.

episodes.name: The Terrible Twos
episodes.overview: Tricky twins turn up - the Terrible Twos, who decide it's time to tickle their friends.

episodes.name: Holes
episodes.overview: Five and friends discover a hole that makes their heads fall off!

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: Five is so good at hide-and-seek she can find the others without looking up from her book.

episodes.name: Six
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks make a new friend who likes to roll dice.

episodes.name: Seven
episodes.overview: It's a rainy day for a picnic, but lucky number Seven makes everything come up rainbows.

episodes.name: Eight
episodes.overview: Numberland is rocked by the arrival of superblock Eight, also known as Octoblock.

episodes.name: Nine
episodes.overview: Numberblock Nine arrives in Numberland, finds a friend in Four, sings a song about squares... and sneezes! Learn all about the number 9 with Numberblock Nine!

episodes.name: Ten
episodes.overview: Children's animation. Ten turns up to tell the Numberblocks what it's like to be a perfect ten. Learn all about the number 10 with Numberblock Ten.

episodes.name: Just Add One
episodes.overview: Children's animation. One's idea of fun is singing, dancing and making friends by adding One. Learn to count to ten by adding one with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Blast Off
episodes.overview: Ten promises to take the others on a trip to the moon, but blasts off on her own. How will they get there? Find out which pairs of numbers add together to make ten with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Counting Sheep
episodes.overview: Six tries to get the cheeky sheep to sleep and discovers that two (or three) heads are better than one. Learn how to share the number 6 into equal parts with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Double Trouble
episodes.overview: One explores the Double Dungeon of Doom in search of the golden apples, doubling herself all the way up to Octoblock. Learn how to double and halve numbers up to 8 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Three Threes
episodes.overview: When Nine needs a helping hand, he turns into a talented trio of circus blocks, the Three Threes. Learn how to share the number 9 into equal parts with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Odds and Evens
episodes.overview: Children's animation. The Numberblocks play a game of bounceball, with the Even Tops versus the Odd Blocks. Learn about odd and even numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Fluffies
episodes.overview: One finds a furball, two of them tickle Two and soon Numberland is full of fluffies!

episodes.name: The Two Tree
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks find a magic Two Tree and play an action-packed game of throwing twos.

episodes.name: Numberblock Castle
episodes.overview: One, Two, Three and Four go on a castle-exploring adventure, making friends along the way.

episodes.name: Ten Green Bottles
episodes.overview: One of Ten's bottles accidentally falls off the wall, setting off a numbery hullabaloo.

episodes.name: Once Upon a Time
episodes.overview: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about the first five Numberblocks. Learn all about the numbers one, two, three, four and five with Numberblocks One to Five.

episodes.name: Blockzilla
episodes.overview: Coming now to a screen near you - the monster tale of a colossal creature who really, really likes bigger numbers. Learn about comparing numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Numberblocks Express
episodes.overview: Learn all the number bonds up to five with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Fruit Salad
episodes.overview: Find out how to split numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Zero
episodes.overview: Learn all about the number zero with Numberblocks Zero.

episodes.name: Now We Are Six to Ten
episodes.overview: Learn all about the numbers 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Numberblobs
episodes.overview: Children's animation. Sing along to the Numberblocks counting song with the Numberblocks' favourite friends. Learn to count to ten with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Building Blocks
episodes.overview: When an alien ship crashes in Numberland, the Numberblocks decide to help the alien get back home. The alien can create lots of blocks like the Numberblocks, so they build a tower into the sky.

episodes.name: Peekaboo!
episodes.overview: Children's animation. The number friends take turns hiding behind each other in a song and dance all about bigger and smaller. Learn about comparing numbers.

episodes.name: Hiccups
episodes.overview: Children's animation. Every time Numberblock Nine hiccups, he falls to pieces- until the others find an unexpected cure. Learn about splitting numbers into smaller numbers.

episodes.name: What's the Difference?
episodes.overview: Seven shows the others how to be lucky: ask a number friend to jump on your head! But how do you know which friend? Find out how to tell the difference between two numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Numberblock Rally
episodes.overview: Ten riders, ten pedal-powered cars, but only one can lift the trophy. Welcome to the Numberblock Rally! Learn about taking away with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Five and Friends
episodes.overview: When Five and friends go missing from the five-star ball, Six to Ten discover they are all Five-and-a-friend! Learn about splitting numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Octoblock to the Rescue!
episodes.overview: The terribly naughty Terrible Twos are making custard pies and Octoblock is all tied up. Can his friends save the day? Discover ways to make eight with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Ten Again
episodes.overview: The number friends all want to do different things today, so rocket Ten finds a clever way to do them all. Learn all the ways to add to ten with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Flatland
episodes.overview: Squarey, we're not in Numberland any more! Four visits Flatland, where the flat shapes live, and becomes a real square. Learn about 2D shapes with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Pattern Palace
episodes.overview: One and her chums carefully cross the pattern puzzle paths over the magic moats to get to the Pattern Palace. Learn about patterns with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Legend of Big Tum
episodes.overview: A big hairy monster with a big hairy tummy who loves puzzles? Find out who is in Big Tum's tum! Learn how to find missing numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Mirror, Mirror
episodes.overview: One makes a wish that the magic mirror could make lots of friends at once, and pretty soon it's pandemonium. Learn about repeat addition with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Wrong Number
episodes.overview: It was a grey day in the big city. One was wondering where her next case would come from when a square silhouette appeared at the door... Learn how to be a number detective with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Eleven
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks make a new friend, football fan Eleven, who gets them all in training for the big match. Learn all about the number 11 with Numberblock Eleven!

episodes.name: Twelve
episodes.overview: Ten and Two make Twelve, who discovers she is a super-rectangle with amazing special powers. Learn all about the number 12 with Numberblock Twelve!

episodes.name: The Way of the Rectangle
episodes.overview: Twelve shows the others how to put their blocks into columns and rows - and master the way of the rectangle. Learn about numbers that make rectangle shapes with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Ride the Rays
episodes.overview: A fantastic treat awaits the Numberblocks if they can figure out how to ride the rays to the top of Ray Canyon. Solve a number puzzle with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Block Star
episodes.overview: Twelve and friends go on a spectacular space mission to save Numberland from the mysterious Block Star. Learn how to split numbers into equal groups with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Thirteen
episodes.overview: Uh-oh. Unlucky Thirteen falls apart whenever anyone mentions his name. Learn all about the number 13 with Numberblock Thirteen!

episodes.name: Fourteen
episodes.overview: Meet extreme Fourteen, the plucky skateboarder.

episodes.name: Fifteen
episodes.overview: Hush, hush! Agent Fifteen is here, with a new way to save the day.

episodes.name: Tween Scenes
episodes.overview: It's time for a bedtime story all about Numberblocks Eleven to Fifteen.

episodes.name: Step Squads
episodes.overview: Only Step Squad can save One's balloon - but what if there's more than one Step Squad?

episodes.name: Fifteen's Minute of Fame
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks put on a talent show full of terrific number tricks, but it doesn't quite go according to plan. Learn all about the numbers 1 to 15 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: On Your Head
episodes.overview: When their numberlings fall off, the Numberblocks have to work out who they are and how numbers work. Learn about place value with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Ten's Place
episodes.overview: Welcome to Ten's Place, where trainer Ten puts her friends through their paces with a high-energy number workout. Learn about numbers that are 'ten-and-a-bit' with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Balancing Bridge
episodes.overview: It's all in the balance as the Numberblocks try to make it across a very wobbly bridge. Learn about adding with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Sixteen
episodes.overview: Meet the really big square who always gets the party started: Sixteen! Learn all about the number 16 with Numberblock Sixteen.

episodes.name: Square Club
episodes.overview: Things get totally out of hand at a Square Club meeting - until a certain someone arrives to save the day. Learn all about square numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Seventeen
episodes.overview: Meet the artist known as Seventeen, who likes to paint 17 of everything. Learn all about the number 17 with Numberblock Seventeen!

episodes.name: Eighteen
episodes.overview: Meet Eighteen, the speedy super-rectangle who was born to ride the rays. Learn all about the number 18 with Numberblock Eighteen!

episodes.name: Loop the Loop
episodes.overview: Super rectangle Eighteen shows the others how to ride the rays on the super-duper looper. Learn about numbers that can make rectangle shapes with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Nineteen
episodes.overview: New Numberblock Nineteen discovers she's a one-off with a hidden talent for shape-shifting. Learn all about the number 19 with Numberblock Nineteen!

episodes.name: Twenty
episodes.overview: Are you ready for the big dance number? Numberblock Twenty struts his stuff and dances the Two Tens Tango. Learn all about the number 20 with Numberblock Twenty!

episodes.name: Tall Stories
episodes.overview: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about Numberblocks Sixteen to Twenty. Learn all about the numbers 16, 17, 18, 19 and 20 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Flights of Fancy
episodes.overview: Rocket Ten and friends blast off into space for a rhyming adventure to visit planets 11 to 20. Explore numbers 11 to 20 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: I Can Count to Twenty
episodes.overview: The Numberblobs challenge Twenty to a singing count-off. Who can count to 20 in the most original ways? Learn how to count up and down and in steps with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Heist
episodes.overview: Can Sixteen to Twenty use their special skills to sneak past the robot guards at the Museum of Numbers? Learn about the special properties of numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Sign of the Times
episodes.overview: Super-speedy Numberblock Eighteen discovers a faster way to add a number together lots of times. Learn how multiplication works with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Fun Times Fair
episodes.overview: Super-rectangle Twelve helps the super-excited Numberblobs work out how many tokens they need for each fairground ride. Learn about multiplication with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Lair of Shares
episodes.overview: One and friends can only escape from the Lair of Shares by learning how to share and solving the puzzles inside. Find out about sharing and division with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Terrible Twosday
episodes.overview: They came from outer space to divide the Numberblocks into Twos. Who can stop the invasion of division with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Divide and Drive
episodes.overview: Three invites the others to her super new go-kart track, where you must divide into Threes to drive. Learn how division works with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Twenty-One and On
episodes.overview: Twenty and chums find out what happens when you go past bus stop 20. Learn about the numbers 21, 22 and 23 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: We're Going on a Square Hunt
episodes.overview: The squares explore an ancient temple in search of a really, really big square. Learn more about square numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Thirty's Big Top
episodes.overview: Welcome to the Big Top, where Thirty and friends show off their circus tricks. Learn about the numbers 30, 40 and 50 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Land of the Giants
episodes.overview: Five and friends discover a way to make themselves ten times bigger! Learn how to count, add and think in tens with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Fifty
episodes.overview: Superstar Fifty rocks out the Numberland stadium with her shining gold guitar. Learn how to count up in fives with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Sixty's High Score
episodes.overview: It's time to meet Sixty and friends in a rocket-powered game of How Many Tens. Learn all about the numbers 60, 70, 80 and 90 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Big One
episodes.overview: One has found a way to keep adding Ones all the way to Ninety-nine. But what on earth comes next? Learn to count to 99 or so with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: One Hundred
episodes.overview: One Hundred shows us what she's made of in a big song about being big. Learn all about the number 100 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: One Thousand and One
episodes.overview: One wonders if anyone could be bigger than One Hundred, and has a big think about some very big numbers indeed. Learn about huge numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: More to Explore
episodes.overview: It's time for the grand finale but the number fun doesn't stop here: there's so much more to explore! Step into the wonderful, wider world of numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Your Turn
episodes.overview: It's time for some bouncy fun as the Numberblobs take over the show. Learn about number lines, comparing numbers and more with the Numberblobs.

episodes.name: Now You See Us
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks discover a magic spell that makes them all invisible. Uh-oh! Learn how to write numbers with Numberblocks Zero to Nine.

episodes.name: Tens Top Ten
episodes.overview: Ten presents a rundown of the top hit songs in Numberland. Learn number bonds to six, seven, eight, nine and ten with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Whats My Number?
episodes.overview: Welcome to the game show where you don't count, you see the amount! Join the Numberblocks and learn how to recognise numbers of things without counting them.

episodes.name: Fun Times One Times Table
episodes.overview: One goes in search of the legendary One Times Table. Sing along and learn the One Times Table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Many Friends of Twenty
episodes.overview: Twenty enters the Pattern Palace to find out who his Twenty-friends are. Learn about number bonds to 20 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Ten Vaulting
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks compete in the finals of the Ten-vaulting contest. Learn about adding past ten with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Twoland
episodes.overview: What if Two was the first Numberblock? Imagine that! Learn about even numbers up to 20 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Two Times Shoe Shop
episodes.overview: Two discovers a magical shoe shop and the even more magical Two Times Table. Sing along and learn the two times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Odd Side Story
episodes.overview: How do the Odd Blocks and Even Tops work out who's best? Dance! Learn about odd and even numbers to 20 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: How Rectangly
episodes.overview: Twenty-One helps some new friends find out how many rectangles they can make. Learn about the numbers 23 and 24 and explore arrays with the Numberblocks

episodes.name: Rectangle Racers
episodes.overview: At the Rays Track, Twenty-Four is ready to race all day and all night! Learn about the different arrays numbers can make with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: The Team Factor
episodes.overview: Welcome to the Team Tag Arena for another exciting match! Who will be left standing? Learn about numbers that can split into equal parts with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Hidden Talents
episodes.overview: Twenty-Six enters Fifteen's Talent Show... and finds some hidden talents! Learn about the number 26, and how it splits into two thirteens with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Making Patterns
episodes.overview: Twenty-Seven and Twenty-Eight explore the new Pattern Wall at the Gallery. Learn about the numbers 27 and 28 and explore number patterns with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Now in 3D
episodes.overview: Octonaughty returns with a whole new dimension of naughtiness. This calls for a whole new dimension of superhero! Learn about cubes, and other ways of arranging blocks in three dimensions with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Club Picnic
episodes.overview: There are so many clubs for Numberblocks to belong to – it's time for Twenty-Nine to figure out where he belongs! Learn about grouping numbers by numerical properties with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Too Many Threes
episodes.overview: Three's attempts to hide in the Clubhouse get increasingly tricky in a slapstick comedy of Threes! Learn which numbers are multiples of three, with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Circus of Threes
episodes.overview: Roll up, roll up, roll up as the spectacular Three Times Table puts on a show to remember. Learn the three times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Figure It Out
episodes.overview: Twenty-One reveals her six-step plan for figuring out Numberblocks - and takes some friends along for the ride. Learn different ways to explore the properties of a number with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Snow Day Doubles
episodes.overview: It's Numberblocks on ice as Thirty-Two and friends have fun halving and doubling in the snow. Learn about doubling and halving with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Steps Versus Squares
episodes.overview: The annual Steps vs Squares treasure hunt doesn't quite go to plan when a new Numberblock joins in. Learn about square numbers and number patterns with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Puzzle Square
episodes.overview: Puzzle-master Thirty-Six challenges the others to find a way into Puzzle Square by opening locks with Numberblocks. Learn about solving problems with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Four on the Floor
episodes.overview: Four and friends bust some big moves on the dance floor with the Four Times Table. Learn the four times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Sky High Fives
episodes.overview: Five gets ready to perform at the Tower of Rock with a little help from the Five Times Table. Learn the five times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: One Giant Step Squad
episodes.overview: Meet Fifty-Five, the step squad leader and rocket ship captain who's always ready to blast into space. Learn about adding and number patterns with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Square on the Moon
episodes.overview: The big squares set out to land a square on the moon using square power alone. Learn about big square numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Heroes with Zeroes
episodes.overview: When there's trouble in space, Ten and the Ten Times Table rocket to the rescue. Learn the ten times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: What If?
episodes.overview: What if there was a way to explore every possible question? Imagine that! Learn the power of asking questions with the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: 100 Ways to Leave the Planet
episodes.overview: It's time for the biggest adventure of all – there's a whole universe to explore. Get ready to be a number explorer with everything you've learned from the Numberblocks.

episodes.name: Painting by Numbers
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks are painting each other on their canvases, but Three has painted Two with one too many blocks. She realises her mistake and disguises herself as Two to convince the other Numberblocks she has got it right. Soon, she learns that no matter the colour of your blocks, it's the number that really counts.

episodes.name: Leap Blob
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks and Numberblobs have to do some clever counting to cross a sticky swamp and reach the perfect place for a picnic.

episodes.name: Ice and Dice
episodes.overview: One, Two and Three use a dice-making machine to figure out how to give everyone a fair go. They explore the properties of dice and mathematical fairness.

episodes.name: Go Go Domino
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks play dominoes and try to reach the golden double six domino and win a prize. They learn about the different patterns on the faces.

episodes.name: Ten in the Bed
episodes.overview: Ten puts the Numberblobs to sleep by singing them a special version of the nursery rhyme Ten in the Bed.

episodes.name: Shape Party
episodes.overview: Four and Two dive into Flatland to go to a shape party! They meet a variety of 2D shapes - circles, different-sized triangles, quadrilaterals and many more - and learn all about their properties, before enjoying a performance of an impressive shape dance.

episodes.name: Can We Have Our Ball Back?
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks learn to make 3D shapes using 2D ones.

episodes.name: Cuboid Castle
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks build a magnificent play fort for the Numberblobs, exploring the use of cubes, cuboids, pyramids and prisms.

episodes.name: On My Way to Numberblock Fair
episodes.overview: One is on her way to Numberblock Fair, using positional language and a map.

episodes.name: Octoblock and the Path of Justice
episodes.overview: Octonaughty is up to no good in the town centre, so Octoblock sets out to track him down. Using a map, he finds his way - but will he reach it in time?

episodes.name: Five's Handy Shop
episodes.overview: Five opens a handy new shop and helps her friends learn the value of money and how to combine lots of pennies into bigger ones.

episodes.name: As Tall as the Sun
episodes.overview: Six and her friends are growing sunflowers, but some are taller than others. Using a ladder, they measure whose sunflower is the tallest and learn about measuring length

episodes.name: Feeding Time
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks transport block fruit to Blockzilla and learn about weight using a pair of balancing scales.

episodes.name: Rockets and Rekenreks
episodes.overview: Ten launches her rocket Rides into space using a rekenrek, a counting frame with ten beads on each row, which helps calculate the value of each ride into pennies.

episodes.name: The Pattern of Patterns
episodes.overview: In the Pattern Palace, Six sings a song telling us about the different types of pattern all around us. Can you spot them all?

episodes.name: Grid Unlocked
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks turn themselves around to save the Times Tables' 5 by 5 booster grid!

episodes.name: Friendly Fours' Beach Day
episodes.overview: Numberblock Four has organised a beach day and sandcastle competition for the Friendly Fours. Let's head to the beach and learn how to count in fours with Numberblocks Four to Forty.

episodes.name: All-Star Line-Up
episodes.overview: It's time for a star-studded evening with the family of Five's All-star Line-up. The Numberblobs watch performances from Numberblocks Five, Ten, Fifteen, Twenty and Twenty-Five. But where are the rest of the Five Times Table friends?

episodes.name: Rescue Racers
episodes.overview: Meet two new super-duper rectangles as they figure themselves out! Forty-Eight is 8 lots of Six and 6 lots of Eight, and teleporter Forty-Two is 7 lots of Six and 6 lots of Seven.

episodes.name: The Rolling Sixes
episodes.overview: It's time for Table Spinners, a game show hosted by Numberblock One. Today's contestant is none other than the Six Times Table. Her task is to try and identify the order of a special team - the Rolling Sixes.

episodes.name: Remix the Sixes
episodes.overview: Meet the Six Times Table. If you're stuck on Six, she's got tricks and quick fixes! She loves to rhyme about all the Numberblocks that are part of her team. With a cool mixing deck, Six helps the Six Times Table count up to Sixty!

episodes.name: Grid Game Galore
episodes.overview: Numberblock Six is preparing for her board game club when Fifty-Six passes by outside. Six is a little mixed up, thinking it's her guest of honour, and pulls Fifty-Six into the room. But what Six doesn't realise is that Fifty-Six is not the guest she was waiting for. Fifty-Six is a superhero, who just happened to be passing by.

episodes.name: The Rainbow Makers
episodes.overview: The Rainbow Sevens have gathered to make one big Rainbow Seven mural. Each of the Rainbow Sevens have their own rainbow styles, underneath one great big colourful rainbow.

episodes.name: Sail the Seven Seas
episodes.overview: Ahoy there! Join the Seven Times Table as he sails the seven seas in search of the rainbow's end. The Seven Times Table is a jolly friend, who brings good luck. He's very clever, and with Sevens he never gets stuck. He collects his crew as he sings his Seven Times sea shanty.

episodes.name: We Need Another Hero
episodes.overview: When the octo-alert system goes out of control, it's up to Octoblock to assemble the Super Eights to save the day. Meet the Numberblocks that make up the Eight Times Table!

episodes.name: Super Eights Assemble
episodes.overview: Join the Eight Times Table as he calls upon his team of superheroes, from Eight to Eighty.

episodes.name: Seventy-Two's Super Surprise
episodes.overview: When Octoblock gets trapped by Octonaughty, he calls on Seventy-Two to save the day.

episodes.name: The Magical Nines
episodes.overview: Ninety puts on a magic show to help the Numberblobs discover who's in the Nine Times Table.

episodes.name: Nine's Time to Shine
episodes.overview: The Nine Times Table shows how you can add ten and take one away to make Nine's friends.

episodes.name: Space Division
episodes.overview: One Hundred assembles a Space Division to investigate a mysterious signal.

episodes.name: The Third Button
episodes.overview: Three has lost one of her buttons! Can detective Numberblock One help find it?

episodes.name: The Great Bug Race
episodes.overview: One to Four's pet bugs are racing on special tracks, but can they follow the perimeter?

episodes.name: The Big Picture
episodes.overview: It's Numberblock Seventeen's area art challenge! Who can find the area of a canvas?

episodes.name: Space Repair
episodes.overview: One needs to fix the space satellite to power up a special show.

episodes.name: Capacity for Magic
episodes.overview: Nine and friends learn all about capacity.

episodes.name: How Many Smoothies?
episodes.overview: Five's new smoothie café is open! Can the Numberblocks get the orders right?

episodes.name: Odd Block Club
episodes.overview: The Odd Blocks are meeting for their special club. Can Numberblock One join it?

episodes.name: Five Makes a Wish
episodes.overview: Five must work with her friends to reach the stars and make a wish.

episodes.name: Number Rescue, Go!
episodes.overview: The Numberland Rescue Team take on a series of urgent missions for the Numberblobs.

episodes.name: The Best House Band in Numberland
episodes.overview: Numberblocks Six to Ten sing about parts and wholes, and the numbers they have inside.

episodes.name: Double Duets
episodes.overview: When it's karaoke time in Numberland, One to Five make it twice as fun by doubling up.

episodes.name: Double Doors, Double Locked
episodes.overview: It's the double doors challenge! How will the Numberblocks solve Fifteen's puzzles?

episodes.name: The All-Knowing Nine
episodes.overview: Nine finds new ways to add numbers as he puts on a magic show for the Numberblobs.

episodes.name: Subtraction Somersaults
episodes.overview: Thirteen is learning to jump and take away some blocks. What's left?

episodes.name: Tenpin Tournament
episodes.overview: Who will win the Numberblocks bowling tournament?

episodes.name: Five's Super Sorter
episodes.overview: The toys in Numberblock Five's new toy library are all mixed up! How can Numberblock Two find something to play with? Luckily, their new friend, Sorty the Super Sorter, helps them discover that toys can be sorted by type, colour, shape and size. It’s easy to see them all and find the perfect toy when they are sorted neatly into categories.

episodes.name: Back in the Box!
episodes.overview: When the Numberblocks finish playing games in the park, Numberblock One suggests a tidying up game called back in the box. Everyone rushes to count all the bats, skittles, hoops and balls back into their boxes, but One soon discovers that it’s hard to counts lots of things at once. With Five's help, One learns to keep track by counting in fives

episodes.name: Five's Fruit Festival
episodes.overview: It’s an exciting day in Numberland! Five is having a fantastic fruit festival. The Numberblock friends help deliver the fruit, but Five isn’t sure how much of each fruit she will need. Will she need lots of apples? Maybe she won’t need many pears? Luckily, Four has a solution. He shows the friends how to use a pictogram that will help them work out exactly what she needs.

episodes.name: I'll Vote for That!
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks have so many fun ideas, how can they choose what to do next? Build a pirate ship or a rocket? Play stampolines, or maybe have a picnic? Ten suggests that they all vote... but what is a vote? Ten explains how it works, and the Numberblock friends have fun choosing together.

episodes.name: The Pyramid of Puzzles
episodes.overview: The friends visit a puzzling pyramid that’s all about bar charts. To get inside and discover what mysteries it holds, they must learn how to read the charts. Join the brave friends as they crack the codes and solve the most important puzzle of all - how to get out again!

episodes.name: One's Fix-it Shop
episodes.overview: When Numberblock One opens a fix-it shop, her friends bring broken things that need to be repaired. Using her special goggles, One works out how many missing parts they require from the boxes of bits and pieces in her workshop. How many parts does Two need to make one whole sledge? And what about Three’s rocket? Once they have found everything, One uses her brand new magical workbench to put the pieces together to make the toys whole.

episodes.name: Happy Campers
episodes.overview: One is off on a camping adventure, but it can be lonely being the only one. Luckily, Two joins her just in time for a picnic. One puts a picnic blanket down, which is split into two equal parts - one part for One and one part for Two. When they get to the camp ground, they are joined by Three and Four, and together they discover how to split the camping space and baguette into equal parts.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Fraction Island
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks are on an adventure exploring Fraction Island. They are curious to learn why there are four islands when their map only shows one. When they meet a new friend, One Whole, they realise that they need to explore all the islands and find more Fraction Friends if they want to solve the mystery!

episodes.name: Fractions Are a Piece of Cake
episodes.overview: Numberblock One has been invited to a party with the Fraction Friends. One meets One Whole and gives them a whole apple, but once the party starts, the food must be shared in different amounts. How will one whole cake, pie and pizza be shared between the Fraction Friends? Luckily, the friends have a special song that can help them work it all out.

episodes.name: Octonaughty and the Fractionater
episodes.overview: Octo-alert! Lots of things in Numberland have been split into halves, thirds and four equal parts. There’s only one block naughty enough to cause such mischief - it’s Octonaughty. Octoblock catches up with Octonaughty in The Museum of Numbers as he causes havoc with his new invention, the Fractionator. Octonaughty is splitting things into equal parts to try to steal the Golden Infinity, but how can Octoblock save the day when Octonaughty has the power to split him into four equal parts?

episodes.name: You're Five Ones and I'm Five Tens
episodes.overview: Testing: one, two, three, four, five! Rockstar Numberblock Five is rehearsing for a music concert, but will she ever be as good as superstar Numberblock Fifty? When Fifty sings a cool song that shows Five all the ways in which they are similar, Five learns that they are not so different after all - it’s just a matter of size.

episodes.name: The Forest of Tens
episodes.overview: Thirty-Six and Forty-Five are exploring the Forest of Tens on a special quest. But what is the special something they need to find and bring to Ten? There are plenty of tricky clues to solve along the way before they can complete their magical mission.

episodes.name: All the Numbers I Can Be
episodes.overview: One is looking through her telescope and spots One Hundred zooming through the sky, splitting into different Numberblocks. But how many numbers can One Hundred make? On a musical journey through space, One Hundred shows One all the numbers she has inside.

episodes.name: The Rings of Unity
episodes.overview: The Numberblocks Space Division are on a mission to investigate a signal coming from the depths of space - until a strange planet pulls them off course and splits them into hundreds, tens and ones. How will they escape the planet's rings? One Hundred takes charge and knows just what to do. But can the Numberblocks make the right number to help them teleport away?

episodes.name: The Space Signal
episodes.overview: At last, the Numberblocks Space Division has reached the mysterious space cloud that’s been sending out a signal. What’s hiding inside? It’s time for Space Division to divide! Using the power of sevens, eights and nines, they work together to clear away the cloud and discover what’s inside!

seasons.overview: Second half of series 8 (TMDB won't unlock season 8 to add these)
